description: A jolly, white-bearded man in a red suit with white fur trim tilts his head back to drink from a glass bottle by a brick fireplace. Stockings hang on the mantel, a holly garland is across the top, and a burlap sack of toys (a doll, a drum, wrapped gifts) sits at his feet. The style is a loose oil-painting look with dark edges and warm firelight, filling the whole square.
